notes.title: 2024年9月5日発売に向けて
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101985/b82c5d6a1a513ae14f5512692c7e201c2fabfab2.png[/img]

Hello.

SUPER SHAKING GIRL!!! will be released on September 5.
Let's review now the differences between the Unity 1week version (the original version) and the production version (this product) that is currently available to the public.

[b]Three Girls[/b].
The number of girls increases from one in the original version to three! Each girl has a different speed and distance to swing the cola. The second and third girls can be unlocked by clearing Stage 2 and Stage 3 of the Adventure Mode, respectively.

[b]Addition of Adventure Mode and expansion of Endless Mode[/b].
An adventure mode has been added in which players fly upward to reach the goal in a total of six stages. A variety of stages await you, from space to futuristic cities to fantasy worlds.
Some of the stages even feature boss enemies.

You want to fly as high as you can and aim for the heights. For such players, there is an endless mode with no altitude limit. Endless Mode is unlocked by clearing each stage of Adventure Mode, and can be challenged.

[b]Game Controller Support[/b].
Since this is an action game, of course you want to play it with a controller, right? In the full version, you can of course enjoy the game with a controller (or a conventional keyboard)!

This is the first casual game from WakuWaku Games, and we hope you will enjoy it with ease and comfort.
You can also enjoy it on Steam Deck.

See you soon!

notes.title: Release Date Reveal!!
notes.content:
Hello everyone.
Today, We have some special news to share with you. It is...

SUPER SHAKING GIRL !!! will be released on [b]September 5[/b]!

SUPER SHAKING GIRL!!! is an action game in which you control up to three unique “Girls” and use the power of cola to soar high into the sky, aiming for any height you can reach. With the power of the girls and your own playing skills, it is not impossible to fly out of the stratosphere and continue flying to the far reaches of the universe. Leaderboard support allows you to compete with the best challengers from around the world. For casual gamers and those who are tired of AAA games and want to play something a little lighter, this is the game for you.

[previewyoutube=cmCWsRSbcFc;full][/previewyoutube]
We are very happy to announce that we are finally able to bring the game to you.
We hope you will enjoy [b]SUPER SHAKING GIRL!!![/b]
